in_hebrew.name: Lowell
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Lowell הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. Derived from the Old English word 'hlow' meaning 'hollow' or 'low-lying'. The name was popular among early settlers in New England due to its association with the rolling hills and meadows of the region.

in_latin.name: Lowell
in_latin.long_meaning: Lowell est nomen Christianum cum profunda significatione spirituali in cultura Christiana. Derived from the Old English word 'hlow' meaning 'hollow' or 'low-lying'. The name was popular among early settlers in New England due to its association with the rolling hills and meadows of the region.
